experiment_type: new offline controls on exactly regenerated archived PDE instances
historical_replay_limitation: Exact ground-truth regeneration and first-query RHS replay do not establish identical historical solution grids or numerical implementations for all runs; historical logs lack per-run implementation hashes.

protocol.minimum_solve_queries: 4N, enforced by the existing interface; fitted LHS has 3N columns and forcing is fitted separately
protocol.scoring: Sum over a,b,c,f of maximum absolute coefficient error, using unrounded internal estimates, matching final PREDICT scoring; strict E < threshold. Displayed 8dp scores, matching intermediate historical error curves, are also saved and threshold agreement audited.
protocol.selection_information: Only public query budget and independent control RNG. No solution, coefficient, oracle-response, error, rank, or condition information enters selection.
protocol.random_sampling: Uniform family choice among sine, boundary-weighted Legendre, exponential, localized Gaussian, boundary-weighted sine. Sine degrees 1..budget and polynomial degrees 0..budget-1 sampled without replacement within each family. Exponential rates uniform[-8,8]; Gaussian centers uniform[.05,.95], log precision uniform[log8,log128].
protocol.scaling: Use expressions as generated, with x(1-x) envelope for all families except pure sine; no post-hoc row normalization or tuning.
protocol.grid_refinement: Refine forward-solution grid and every query integral together; (n_grid-1)*factor+1 points. This is not a noise robustness test.
protocol.forward_solver: Native dense solve at original grid; independently assembled equivalent tridiagonal solve_banded at refined grids, validated against native dense at original grid on all 30 instances.
protocol.aggregation: Pooled randomized runs are descriptive. Per-replicate summaries and per-instance success fractions preserve distinct PDE and randomization units; 10 random replicates do not increase the 30 independent PDE instances.
protocol.design_svd: Joint [G_diff G_adv G_react] and independently column-normalized version; rank tolerance max(shape)*eps*sigma_max. Full singular spectra are saved.
